  > 1. Noise curve: deleting a fraction f of the observed sample gives P_flip(f) = Φ(−z√((1−f)/f)) (RMSE 0.010 over >5,000 cells), not Φ(−z√(1−f)) (RMSE 0.070, biased). So f_q = z²/(z²+c_q²) is below 0.8 only for z ≲ 2 at q = 16%; the intent-vs-noise comparison is a ratio only there and a lower bound above.
  > 2. Under exact refit Q = k*·g_max/gap is not ≥ 1 (≈ 0.97 deletion; ≈ 1.2 flips, density-dependent); the inequality F ≥ z holds only in the linear regime. Q is read only against its same-graph null (already the Brief's rule).
  > Also: k* ≈ z^1.1 N^0.45 empirically (theory: z√N). No change to the question or contributions is needed unless you see one; this is a request to correct the statements, not to re-plan.
